title: Request flamegraph + swimlane inspector for correlation-id drilldowns
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design a compact, actionable trace drilldown focused on a single correlation ID that surfaces a request-level flamegraph and swimlane timeline. Goal: help SREs and product engineers quickly identify high-cost spans, cross-service hotspots, and error clusters without leaving the Console. The view should support span grouping, collapsed detail rows, cost attribution per span, and quick pivot actions (jump to logs, open linked trace in provider, add to eval prompt).
acceptance_criteria: A1: Selecting a correlation ID from dashboards opens the inspector with the flamegraph visible above the timeline
A2: Flamegraph aggregates token cost and latency per span with hover tooltips and linkable span IDs
A3: Swimlane shows parallel spans across resources (model, runtime, region) with filterable lanes
A4: Users can collapse/expand service groups, search spans by name, and filter by status/error code
A5: Quick actions present contextual links: logs, GitHub PRs (if linked), create incident, export trace as JSON
A6: Mobile/responsive layout maintains legibility and supports vertical stacking of flamegraph and timeline
comments: 2026-02-22 Aisha Patel: Initial PRD sketch attached. Focus on reducing time-to-blame for high-cost tail requests. Recommended metrics: p95 latency, per-request token cost, error rate by span.

2026-02-28 Miguel Torres: Wireframes 1.0 ready. Opted to show flamegraph at top to prioritize cost/latency insight before span list. Need direction on whether to show absolute cost or normalized cost per 1000 requests.
2026-03-03 PM review (Ravi Mehta): Prefer absolute cost for billing investigations and normalized for performance tuning. Proposal: toggle in header to switch cost mode.
2026-03-05 Eng feedback (Priya Nair): KV cache spans can be noisy. Suggest a foldable group for cache-related spans and an option to collapse low-latency (<2ms) spans by default.

2026-03-07 Usability testing (5 participants): Users found flamegraph helpful to spot single expensive spans but wanted clearer mapping from flame segments to span rows; added hover highlight that synchronizes across components.
2026-03-10 Design review: Accessibility pass requested — increase color contrast and add keyboard nav for span list. Also add copy-to-clipboard for correlation ID.
2026-03-12 Miguel Torres: Updated prototype with highlight sync, cost toggle, and quick-actions. Requesting engineering estimation and API contract for per-span cost attribution.
2026-03-12 Stakeholder note (SRE lead, Jenna Soto): This view looks promising for incident TTR reduction. Please include an export option to attach traces to incidents in PagerDuty.
